_note: MV-0028: the sim unit's serialized capability view (the 1089 m_Capabilities object a UNIT_CAPABILITIES report carries), generated offline from swarmBuildAdvert() in src/swarm/swarm_caps.hpp. Same role as fc_io.unit.caps.json: compile_op.js --caps resolves do swarm.* against it and the ctx sidecars feed verify_wrap.js.

follow.desc: f=1 follow leader b at slot a (-1 = any); f=2 unfollow; f=3 change follower formation to d

a.desc: follower slot index, -1 = any (required when f=1)

c.desc: follower party id - defaults to this unit

h.desc: min horizontal distance to leader (default KNODE_LENGTH)

v.desc: min vertical distance to leader (default KNODE_LENGTH)

make.desc: promote this unit to swarm leader with formation a (0 = demote)

b.desc: leader party id - defaults to this unit

h.desc: min horizontal distance to followers (default KNODE_LENGTH)

v.desc: min vertical distance to followers (default KNODE_LENGTH)

advert.desc: swarm formation: make promotes this unit to leader (a=formation 0..4), follow makes it follow/unfollow a leader (f=1 follow/2 unfollow/3 change formation)

follower_count.desc: followers registered on this unit as leader

follower_formation.desc: formation this unit flies as follower (0 = unconfirmed)

follower_index.desc: slot this unit occupies in its leader's swarm (-1 = none)

leader.desc: party id of the leader this unit follows (empty = none)
